name: M11-NOV-01a3b2b second full-validator prior-art fixture screen
purpose: Seek two new source-backed positives with central-mechanism-supporting non-target prior art in the current validator's first three papers. This is a bounded fixture-feasibility screen, not a product comparison.

prior_screen.preserved_pair_rule: Keep its exact v1 positive/control drafts and source anchors unchanged; do not repeat or relabel its observed output to select v2 sources.
prior_screen.excluded_families: STMN2/TDP-43, SARS-CoV-2/TMPRSS2, Qa-1b/NKG2A, butyrate/Foxp3, cGAS/Beclin-1, indole/AhR/IL-22, B. fragilis PSA/TLR2, GPR81/lactate, and all of their previous distinct controls.

source_snapshot.provider: NCBI PubMed EFetch, keyless public XML, one batched source-metadata request
source_snapshot.followup_scope: Recent independent papers motivated source selection but do not automatically support every subclaim in the original draft. In particular, the TREM2, GLP-1R and Piezo1 follow-ups cover related axes, not every ligand or signaling step.
source_snapshot.retention: Public PMID permalinks and this source hash are retained; source XML and abstracts are not committed.

validation_boundary.configured_tool: first validation search-category tool: pubmed_fulltext -> pubmed_search_with_fulltext
validation_boundary.query: exact draft[:200], with no source PMID, subject-first rewrite, added terms, date filter or result-conditioned request
validation_boundary.source_id: Article.source_id from the returned dictionary key
validation_boundary.upstream_search: retain selected relaxation rung and all fetched/selected IDs from the maintained tool's bounded trace

positive.draft: GDF15 activates GFRAL-RET signaling in area postrema and NTS neurons, reducing food intake and body weight.

distinct_control.draft: Leptin excites arcuate POMC neurons by direct depolarization and reduced NPY/GABA inhibition, restraining food intake.

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: Both reduce feeding, but GDF15-GFRAL-RET acts through brainstem area-postrema/NTS neurons whereas leptin acts through the arcuate POMC/NPY circuit. Shared appetite words alone do not support either causal path.

positive.draft: TREM2 binds APOE and CLU lipoproteins and promotes microglial uptake of amyloid-beta-lipoprotein complexes.

distinct_control.draft: BACE1's transmembrane domain localizes it to late Golgi and grants access to APP for beta-cleavage.

recent_followup.scope: TREM2-associated microglial function, not independent proof of APOE/CLU ligand binding

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: Both concern amyloid-beta biology, but TREM2-mediated microglial clearance differs from BACE1-mediated APP processing and amyloid production. Alzheimer's vocabulary alone fails central support.

positive.draft: RANKL induces calcineurin-activated NFATc1, driving monocyte-macrophage differentiation into bone-resorbing osteoclasts.

distinct_control.draft: Sclerostin binds LRP5/6 and antagonizes canonical Wnt signaling in osteoblast-lineage cells.

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: Both regulate bone balance, but RANKL/calcineurin/NFATc1 drives osteoclast differentiation while sclerostin/LRP5/6 inhibits osteoblast Wnt signaling.

positive.draft: A pancreatic islet GLP-1 receptor binds GLP-1 with high affinity and activates adenylate cyclase.

distinct_control.draft: DPP-IV cleaves GLP-1 into biologically inactive GLP-1(9-36), rapidly shortening its incretin action in vivo.

recent_followup.scope: Incretin receptor signaling, not the cloning paper's exact adenylate-cyclase step

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: Both involve GLP-1, but receptor binding/second-messenger signaling differs from enzymatic hormone cleavage and inactivation.

positive.draft: Macrophage Piezo1 senses stiffness and raises CaMKII-HIF1alpha-dependent glycolysis, amplifying LPS-induced cytokine release.

distinct_control.draft: In macrophages, LPS-activated TLR4 recruits MyD88 to drive NF-kappaB activation and COX-2 expression.

recent_followup.scope: Piezo1 mechanosensing, not the full CaMKII-HIF1alpha glycolysis chain

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: Both can influence LPS responses, but mechanosensitive Piezo1/CaMKII metabolic signaling differs from TLR4/MyD88 pathogen-pattern signaling.

positive.draft: VHL loss stabilizes HIF-2alpha, whose transactivation domains promote renal carcinoma growth.

distinct_control.draft: In Tsc1-deficient kidneys, FoxO loss permits mTORC1-driven renal tumors by removing a Myc-suppressive checkpoint.

cases_in_fixed_order.overlap_rule: Both concern renal tumors, but VHL/HIF-2alpha oxygen-responsive transcription differs from TSC1/mTORC1 growth signaling with a FoxO/Myc checkpoint.

screening_protocol.source_selection: Six pairs were proposed from primary papers by a read-only Luna 6 xhigh source researcher who saw only v1 dispositions, not raw validator result records. Their order and exact drafts were frozen before any v2 validator call.
screening_protocol.order: Run these six new pairs in fixed order, positive then control, at most one maintained-path call per draft. The existing GPX4 pair is preserved but not re-screened for qualification.
screening_protocol.cache: One new empty campaign cache root with a unique slug/run_id namespace per draft; never reuse the v1 cache.
screening_protocol.credentials: Both server and runner launch with explicit credential-empty environments, exact-zero free mode, ephemeral loopback MCP secret, no model inference and no paid tools.
screening_protocol.spacing: At least 1.2 seconds between outer calls.
screening_protocol.on_first_error_or_rate_limit: Stop the whole screen and retain partial request/result/error and retry-after; never change query, case, provider or call cap to complete the batch.
screening_protocol.labeling: A fresh reviewer blind to case order, arm, rank, PMID, target and source sees only shuffled draft/abstract/blind-ID items. Central support requires the same causal mediator/pathway and biological context; shared nouns or broad topic relevance are related-only. Retain each label and rationale without copying abstracts.
screening_protocol.enrollment: If at least two new positive/control pairs have a central-mechanism-supporting non-target PMID among the initial three, stable primary-paper target/control PMIDs and scientifically distinct controls, take the first two qualifying new pairs in frozen order alongside the unchanged GPX4 pair. No result-conditioned comparison may begin until this triplet and its matched evaluation are separately preregistered.
screening_protocol.if_fewer_than_two: Retain the insufficient screen and evaluate whether a scientifically valid result-conditioned comparison is feasible without post-hoc substitutions; do not silently reject or close the promising candidate.
screening_protocol.later_comparison: The screen itself cannot establish candidate improvement. Freeze exact-target recall, distinct-control non-rejection, provenance/error criteria, equal model settings/evidence/caches, a static-query follow-up control, and a two-search/six-paper cap before product candidate calls.
